onboarding.slide1Body: As early as 1885, Hermann Ebbinghaus measured the "forgetting curve": within days, most of what we just learned is gone.
onboarding.slide2Title: Reviewing at the right moment changes everything
onboarding.slide2Body: Each well-placed review lifts memory back up and flattens the curve. Memoriq uses the FSRS algorithm to schedule every verse at the ideal moment, right before you would forget it.
onboarding.slide3Body: Testing yourself is nearly twice as effective as rereading (Roediger and Karpicke, 2006). Memoriq blurs the verse: you recite out loud, then reveal the phonetics word by word to check yourself.
onboarding.slide4Title: The method of the Prophet ﷺ
onboarding.slide4Body: Sabaq, sabqi, manzil: the hifz tradition has always practiced what cognitive science confirms today. Memoriq brings the two together.
onboarding.slide4Card1Quote: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would listen to the recitation of Jibril whenever he came to him. Once the angel had left, the Prophet would recite the Qur'an exactly the same way."
onboarding.slide4Card1Narrator: On the authority of Ibn 'Abbas (may Allah be pleased with him)
onboarding.slide4Card1Method: Listen attentively first (to a model reciter), then repeat block by block without haste. The companions (like Ibn Mas'ud) used to learn ten verses at a time, not moving on to the next until they had mastered, understood and applied them.
onboarding.slide4Card2Quote: "Keep reviewing the Qur'an regularly. By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, it escapes more quickly than a camel freed from its rope."
onboarding.slide4Card2Narrator: On the authority of Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (may Allah be pleased with him)
onboarding.slide4Card2Source: Reported by Al-Bukhari No. 5033 and Muslim No. 791
onboarding.slide4Card2Method: Never pile up new surahs without a fixed daily time devoted to reviewing what has already been learned.
onboarding.slide4Card3Quote: "When the one who has memorized the Qur'an stands and recites it night and day, he remembers it. If he does not, he forgets it."
onboarding.slide4Card3Narrator: On the authority of Ibn 'Umar (may Allah be pleased with him)
onboarding.slide4Card3Method: Use the freshly learned surah or passage in the day's prayer units (rak'at) to validate the memorization in real conditions.
onboarding.slide4Card4Quote: "The deed most beloved to Allah is the one that is most constant, even if it is small."
onboarding.slide4Card4Narrator: On the authority of 'A'isha (may Allah be pleased with her)
onboarding.slide4Card4Method: Even if one verse a day seems little, regularity wins over quantity.
